choose_card() {
  local candidate='' header='' found=1
  for candidate in front-card reserve-card; do
    header=''
    IFS= read -r header < "$candidate"
    if test "$header" = AVAILABLE; then
      cat -- "$candidate" > gallery-card.txt
      printf 'Chosen: %s\n' "$candidate"
      found=0
    fi
  done
  return "$found"
}
